name: myai-voice-notes
description: Zero-install voice-note PWA with self-hosted server transcription and replies.

scripts.version:sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=fs.readFileSync('sw.js','utf8').match(/const VERSION\s*=\s*'v(\d+)'/);if(!m)throw new Error('no VERSION in sw.js');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));p.version=m[1]+'.0.0';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n');console.log('package.json version set to '+p.version)"
scripts.test:unit: node tests/unit/pure.test.mjs && node tests/unit/core.test.mjs && node tests/unit/recording-lock.test.mjs && node tests/unit/live-view.test.mjs && node tests/unit/platform.test.mjs && node tests/unit/webm-duration.test.mjs && node tests/unit/sw-routing.test.mjs && node tests/unit/baseline-runner.test.mjs && node tests/unit/baseline-contract.test.mjs && node tests/unit/static.test.mjs && node tests/check-syntax.mjs
scripts.test:integration: MYAI_STRICT_TESTS=1 node tests/integration/multitab-integration.mjs && MYAI_STRICT_TESTS=1 node tests/integration/webm-player-integration.mjs && MYAI_STRICT_TESTS=1 node tests/integration/browser-integration.mjs
